display.purpose: One compact title for each main view.

transcript.purpose: Readable live or last-completed dictated text.

title.purpose: Dictation, transcript, settings, and subsection headings.

body.purpose: Descriptions, history text, and concise supporting copy.

label.purpose: Status, field names, toggles, and metadata.

button.purpose: Primary, secondary, text, and destructive action copy.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus and active input focus.

motion.name: state-standard

motion.name: state-toggle
motion.purpose: Toggle track and thumb state changes.

motion.name: overlay-meter

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main save or add action inside a view.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 9px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent); font: 650 12px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--accent-hover); background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.22); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet recovery or system action that should remain available without competing with dictation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); font: 650 12px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #adb2bd; background: var(--surface-subtle); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.22); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Hands-Free Action
components.description: The visibly labeled primary control for starting continuous dictation.
components.css: .ds-record-action { display: inline-flex; min-width: 108px; height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #424bdf; border-radius: 12px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.2); font: 720 11px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-record-action svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-record-action:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.26); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-record-action:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.22); } .ds-record-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The history search control with a compact leading icon.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-field"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5"></circle><path d="m12.25 12.25 4 4"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search dictations"></label>
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: flex; height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-search-field svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search-field input { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font: 400 14px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search-field:hover { border-color: #b5bac4; } .ds-search-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.22); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A persistent destination in the Night Rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; width: 166px; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--sidebar-muted); background: var(--sidebar); font: 600 13px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; stroke: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--sidebar-active); background: #282c33; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.22); } .ds-nav-item:active { color: #fff; background: #34373d; }

components.name: Toggle Row
components.description: A direct setting with title, explanation, and a right-aligned switch.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { position: relative; display: grid; min-height: 48px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toggle-row > span { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-toggle-row strong { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-toggle-row small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-toggle-row input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-toggle-row i { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 21px; border-radius: 99px; background: #b8bdc7; transition: background 170ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-row i::after { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(29, 33, 40, 0.22); content: ""; transition: transform 170ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-row input:checked + i { background: var(--accent); } .ds-toggle-row input:checked + i::after { transform: translateX(15px); } .ds-toggle-row input:focus-visible + i { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.22); }

components.name: Learned Term
components.description: A compact local-vocabulary term with its repetition count.
components.css: .ds-learned-term { display: inline-flex; min-height: 29px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); font: 600 10px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-learned-term small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Recording Overlay
components.description: The compact non-focus-stealing state surface shown above other applications.
components.css: .ds-overlay { display: grid; width: 420px; height: 58px; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--sidebar-active); background: var(--sidebar); box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(11, 13, 17, 0.3); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-overlay-signal { display: flex; width: 34px; height: 34px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--danger); } .ds-overlay-signal i { width: 3px; height: 9px; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; } .ds-overlay-signal i:nth-child(2) { height: 18px; } .ds-overlay-signal i:nth-child(3) { height: 13px; } .ds-overlay-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 3px; } .ds-overlay-copy strong { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 680; } .ds-overlay-copy small { overflow: hidden; color: #aeb4c0; font-size: 10px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-overlay b { color: #aeb4c0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-overlay:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); } .ds-overlay:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.22), 0 16px 38px rgba(11, 13, 17, 0.3); }

narrative.overview:
Parrot is a professional native productivity tool that recedes until the user speaks. Its world combines an ink navigation rail with a cool paper workspace and a single confident cobalt action, creating the feeling of a focused Windows utility rather than a marketing dashboard or decorative AI demo.

The system is compact, direct, and visibly local. Readiness, live dictation, recovery, personalization, and settings follow one continuous command surface; hierarchy comes from typography, tonal contrast, and precise dividers instead of stacked cards. Rounded geometry is reserved for controls and the small recording overlay.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-and-cool-paper desktop shell with a compact persistent rail.
Cobalt interaction color used for the current primary action and focus.
Flat, divider-led content regions with restrained control rounding.
Direct status language and a persistent local-processing signal.
Dense but readable Segoe UI typography suited to a Windows utility.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Action Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt to identify the current primary action or focus, not to decorate entire sections.

rules.name: The State Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green means ready, amber means working, and red means recording, destructive action, or failure; never use these colors ornamentally.

rules.name: The Native Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Segoe UI for every user-facing surface; reserve monospace for diagnostics and never use it as an AI-themed accent.

rules.name: The Compact Confidence Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with weight and spacing before increasing type size; page titles stay compact and transcript text gets the most reading room.

rules.name: The Continuous Workspace Rule
rules.body: Dictation and transcript regions share the canvas and are separated by rules; do not wrap them in independent cards.

rules.name: The Recovery-in-View Rule
rules.body: The first viewport keeps readiness, both dictation modes, live text, recent recoverable work, and local usage totals visible together at the normal window size.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Persistent content stays flat; elevation communicates focus, a primary live action, or a temporary floating layer.

rules.name: The Controls Own the Corners Rule
rules.body: Rounded corners belong to interactive controls and the compact overlay, never to stacked content containers.

dos: Do keep the common path visible as readiness, push-to-talk, hands-free, live transcript, recovery, and local usage.
Do use one-pixel dividers and shared alignment to organize persistent content.
Do keep cobalt concentrated on the primary action, checked state, text action, and focus.
Do pair every colored status indicator with clear text.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and readable secondary copy.
donts: Don't rebuild the workspace as stacked cards, floating panels, or badge collections.
Don't use cream, ornamental gradients, decorative waveforms, or oversized AI-style headlines.
Don't hide hands-free dictation behind an unlabeled icon.
Don't surface engine, model, thread, or diagnostic controls before common dictation behavior.
Don't copy another dictation product's branding, assets, wording, colors, or pixel-level layout.
